data.name: [DAHM/DorHUD] Better Chat Position
data.desc:
### Improves the chat UI for PDTH when using DorHUD.

> **Extract to the mods folder.**

* Moves the chat input field down.
* Slightly increases the chat font size for better readability.

After U23, the chat input field has been positioned lower by default, but DorHUD moves it back up. This mod moves it down to a more suitable position, rather than simply restoring its default placement.

> You can change the font size in *tweakdata.lua*
or just delete the file if you don't want the font size changes.

![](https://storage.modworkshop.net/mods/images/i6MUkH44OwbsXVycyf0nICGgDYJ2y1Sq03N7LEAv.webp)

**Note:** Renamed from *'Better Chat Location'* to *'Better Chat Position'*. Reinstalling is recommended, but auto-updating works fine too—only the folder keeps its old name.

　
 　
[Changelog](https://modworkshop.net/mod/41030?tab=changelog)
data.short_desc: Improves the chat UI for PDTH when using DorHUD.

data.name: F.U.B.A.R. (Difficulty Enhancer)
data.desc:
This is a project I've been working on for quite a good while, good month or two I think? I never really keep up with time these days. Anyhow this will up the difficulty by a lot, especially on Overkill and above. This does that by allowing certain enemies to have additional weapons that they don't normally have, upping the number of specials that spawn as well as the cap on specials, raising the number of cops that can be present, replacing enemies, adding new custom events, adding events and changes from Overkill 145+ onto the lower difficulties such as bulldozers being present in the vault on First World Bank, and having bonus mutators that turns this game into a nightmare for even the most seasoned players.

Here's the trailers for this in case you want some videos to see what you're in for:

Trailer 1: https://youtu.be/41rlyNDLMgw

Trailer 2: https://youtu.be/2IQgn28sCT8


To detail the changes made in more specifics:


Enemy Spawn Changes:

Gensec White Shirt Guards are now replaced with Heavy Swats. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

Gensec Red Shirt Guards are now replaced with Cloakers. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

All Gangsters are now replaced with some kind of law enforcement officer. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

Murky 1 now can be replaced by a Cloaker. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

Murky 2 now can be replaced by a Taser. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

FBI 1 now can be replaced by a Cloaker. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

FBI 2 now can be replaced by a Cloaker or Taser. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

FBI 3 now can be replaced by a Cloaker or Taser. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)


Weapon Changes:

Murkys can now spawn with either an M4 or AK47. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

Cop 2 can now spawn with either a Crosskill 45 or Bronco 44. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

FBI 1 can now spawn with either a BS-9, M4, or Reinbeck. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

FBI 2 can now spawn with either a BS-9 or MP5. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

FBI 3 can now spawn with either a BS-9 or M4. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

Cloakers can now spawn with either a BS-9 or MP5. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

Tasers can now spawn with either an M4 or AK47. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)

Bulldozers can now spawn with a either a AK47, MP5, Brenner, or Reinbeck. (Made Possible By Warmod By BAnXZ)


Assault Time Changes:

Easy - Assault 60s to 120s, Street Assault 30s to 60s. (Made By Me, Added By Base F.U.B.A.R. Mutator)

Normal - Assault 120s to 180s, Street Assault 60s to 90s. (Made By Me, Added By Base F.U.B.A.R. Mutator)

Hard - Assault 180s to 240s, Street Assault 90s to 120s. (Made By Me, Added By Base F.U.B.A.R. Mutator)

Overkill - Assault 240s to 300s, Street Assault 120s to 150s. (Made By Me, Added By Base F.U.B.A.R. Mutator)

Overkill 145+ - Assault 300s to 360s, Street Assault 150s to 180s. (Made By Me, Added By Base F.U.B.A.R. Mutator)

Overkill 193+ - Assault 360s to 420s, Street Assault 180s to 210s. (Made By Me, Added By Base F.U.B.A.R. Mutator)


Special Cap Changes:

Easy - Special Cap 8, Shield Cap 0, Taser Cap 0, Spooc Cap 0, Tank 0 (Made By Me, Added By Base F.U.B.A.R. Mutator)

Normal - Special Cap 8, Shield Cap 1, Taser Cap 1, Spooc Cap 1, Tank 1 (Made By Me, Added By Base F.U.B.A.R. Mutator)

Hard - Special Cap 12, Shield Cap 2, Taser Cap 2, Spooc Cap 2, Tank 1 (Made By Me, Added By Base F.U.B.A.R. Mutator)

Overkill - Special Cap 14, Shield Cap 3, Taser Cap 3, Spooc Cap 3, Tank 2 (Made By Me, Added By Base F.U.B.A.R. Mutator)

Overkill 145+ - Special Cap 16, Shield Cap 4, Taser Cap 4, Spooc Cap 4, Tank 3 (Made By Me, Added By Base F.U.B.A.R. Mutator)

Overkill 193+ - Special Cap 18, Shield Cap 5, Taser Cap 5, Spooc Cap 5, Tank 4 (Made By Me, Added By Base F.U.B.A.R. Mutator)

Bonus Mutators List:

Bonus 1 - Tasers are better at tasing. (One Of B Dawg's Mutator's From Their Overhaul Mod, Added By F.U.B.A.R. Bonus Mutator)

Bonus 2 - Friendly fire is turned on. (One Of B Dawg's Mutator's From Their Overhaul Mod, Added By F.U.B.A.R. Bonus Mutator)

Bonus 3 - You can't see outlines anymore. (One Of B Dawg's Mutator's From Their Overhaul Mod, Added By F.U.B.A.R. Bonus Mutator)

Bonus 4 - Ammo left in a clip will be tossed away when reloading your weapons. (One Of B Dawg's Mutator's From Their Overhaul Mod, Added By F.U.B.A.R. Bonus Mutator)

Bonus 5 - No more automatic reloading. (One Of B Dawg's Mutator's From Their Overhaul Mod, Added By F.U.B.A.R. Bonus Mutator)

Bonus 6 - No more crosshair. (One Of B Dawg's Mutator's From Their Overhaul Mod, Added By F.U.B.A.R. Bonus Mutator)

Bonus 7 - Only FBI units will spawn in during assaults. (One Of B Dawg's Mutator's From Their Overhaul Mod, Added By F.U.B.A.R. Bonus Mutator)

Bonus 8 - Armor regens in chunks now. (One Of B Dawg's Mutator's From Their Overhaul Mod, Added By F.U.B.A.R. Bonus Mutator)

Bonus 9 - Only Murkywater units will be swarming you in Slaughterhouse during assaults. (One Of B Dawg's Mutator's From Their Overhaul Mod, Added By F.U.B.A.R. Bonus Mutator)


Additional Events And Ported Events From Overkill 145+:

Changed spawn point access across most heists that enhances over all difficulty. To list them Shields, Bulldozers, and other units can spawn from behind the riot fences at inkwell as well as from the brick wall behind inkwell and in the back alley you push matt through and the riot fences at the top of Armitage ave near the overkill cola sign on Heat Street. Two unused Armitage ave spawn points on two roof tops have been enabled on Heat Street. Shields, Bulldozers, and other units can spawn from behind the brick walls in the alley and on the rooftops on Panic Room. Shields, Bulldozers, and other units can spawn from the spawns near the 3rd and 4th convoy trucks, and from the ground level inside the scaffolding on the side where you send the prisoner up into the sky on Green Bridge. Fixed Shields and Bulldozers getting trapped on the roof access rooftop spawn near the PR department on floor 22. An unused container yard slaughterhouse roof spawn has been enabled on Slaughterhouse. Shields, Bulldozers, and other units can spawn from the scaffolding in the kitchen and on top of the containers in the container yard. Various spawns all around on Counterfeit have been modified. (Made By Cranky's Mod Emporium And Neonsynth, Added By F.U.B.A.R.+ Mutator)

4 Bulldozers spawn in the vault on First World Bank across all difficulties. (Made By Me, Added By F.U.B.A.R.+ Mutator)

data.desc:
This mod replaces Player Upgrades and Crew Bonuses with Skills and Crew Boosts.

Shoutout to [Loadout Dropdowns](https://modworkshop.net/mod/43115) by [_atom](https://modworkshop.net/user/_atom) for helping me screenshot details of this mod.

**Note**: The description of Reinforced Armor conflicts with "localization_fixes.lua" located in "bugfixes", a mod that comes along with DAHM/Dorhud, so you will have to edit the .lua file and remove the text that replaces the original Protector's description if you want to see the Crew Boost's description.
data.short_desc: A mod that replaces Player Upgrades and Crew Bonuses with Skills and Crew Boosts.

data.name: Real-Life Weapon Names
data.desc:
This mod replaces the fictional weapon names with their real-life names.

Shoutout to the original [Real-Life Weapon Names](https://modworkshop.net/mod/32436) by [The Rant-man](https://modworkshop.net/user/therant-man) for inspiring me and giving me the groundwork to do this in the first place.
data.short_desc: A mod that replaces the fictional weapon names with their real-life names.

data.name: Realistic Weapon Names and Descriptions

This mod gives the weapons more realistic names and descriptions.

Shoutout to [Loadout Dropdowns](https://modworkshop.net/mod/43115) by [_atom](https://modworkshop.net/user/_atom) for helping me screenshot details of this mod.
data.short_desc: A mod that gives the weapons more realistic names and descriptions.

data.name: Murkywater SWAT
data.desc: With resources stretched thin, the police has begun outsourcing high-risk operations to Murkywater, deploying private military contractors in place of Heavy SWAT officers.
data.short_desc: A mod that replaces the models of the Heavy SWAT with the models of the Murkywater Contractors.

data.name: FBI SWAT
data.desc: The FBI has had enough and is now sending in their own SWAT teams to destroy the Clowns and restore law and order.
data.short_desc: A mod that replaces the models of the Blue SWAT and the Sniper with the models of the FBI Agents and the models of the FBI Agents with the models of FBI 1.

data.name: Heavier SWAT
data.desc: *Heavier* SWAT teams are being deployed in response to the rise in violent crime. Better armored and more heavily equipped, they are sent in when standard tactical units are no longer enough.
data.short_desc: This mod replaces the models of the Heavy SWAT with the model of the Shield.
